# ---- copies (any scope): how many registered libraries hold the work.
kehillah_lib_copies_work_targum_onkelos = {
	value = 0
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = kehillah_libraries
		limit = { exists = holder is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos } }
		add = 1
	}
}
